 Petrol price reduced to Rs338 per litre, diesel set at Rs371 
 Web Desk 11:25 PM | November 10, 2026 Business Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Facebook Share on Twitter The federal government has announced a fresh reduction in fuel prices, lowering petrol and high-speed diesel (HSD) rates to provide some relief to consumers.
 Under a notification issued by the Petroleum Division, petrol has become cheaper by Rs8 per litre, while the price of high-speed diesel has been cut by Rs7.
 With the latest adjustment, petrol will now cost Rs338 per litre, compared with the previous rate of Rs346. Diesel prices have also declined from Rs378 to Rs371 per litre.
 The reduction is expected to ease fuel expenses for motorists and transport operators, while the lower diesel rate may help reduce freight and transportation costs.
 First winter storm floods thousands of Gaza tents, killing children and leaving thousands stranded 
 According to the notification, the revised prices will take effect from midnight on November 10 (Wednesday) and remain in force until November 11.
